title: Edge conditional backup metadata v1
description: The conditional member of GET /backup?conditional=true, not the full backup or a restore precondition. All rows and tokens come from one complete primary transaction snapshot. Namespace and row tokens have separate state bindings; only the namespace If-Match header authorizes conditional restore.

x-contract.name: admin-conditional-snapshot
x-contract.edge_availability: Released since Ferrum Edge v0.9.11; unchanged wire shape re-read at v0.9.15 source 25b37395ff61bfea0f3ffd189d9011c4984fa755. From v0.9.13 the namespace token MACs a bounded snapshot digest under the namespace_snapshot.v2 domain: earlier namespace tokens fail closed with 412, and a namespace over the 64 MiB canonical bound returns 507. Edge v0.9.14 documents the conditional backup ETag as a namespace state token for restore If-Match only, not a validator of the response bytes. Unchanged wire shape re-read at Edge v0.9.17 source 669c574c1d1e88e84dccb26a8159939e6694644d.

provenance.note: Transcribed OpenAPI metadata shape, with strong quoted token syntax from preconditions.rs. Tokens are keyed, opaque state validators; this schema checks syntax only.

namespace_etag.description: Quoted strong tag for the complete coherent namespace state, including durable revision, ownership, trust, associations and registry metadata. Equal to the conditional backup ETag header; use only as namespace If-Match on restore.

StrongETag.description: Opaque, quoted strong entity-tag syntax using visible ASCII accepted by the owner precondition parser. Preserve the token verbatim. JSON validation cannot establish cryptographic validity, freshness, authorization, or whether this is a row or namespace tag.

ResourceETagMap.description: Resource id to the same quoted strong tag individual CRUD reads issue for that complete stored row. Empty maps are valid. A row tag cannot authorize namespace replacement.
